verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's own AI-tools page says you can "Create campaigns with the AI you already use. Without leaving the chat". That is a first-party claim of connecting external AI assistants to Mailchimp, but nothing in the evidence names MCP or describes a server endpoint, tools, or setup. The llms.txt probe shows only AI-readable docs, not an agent connection. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that the integration is an official MCP server, an endpoint/install documentation, the list of exposed tools and auth model, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
